description: Q-Leap attends the Journée Française des Tests Logiciels (JFTL) 2024 in Paris on June 11, the CFTL event for software testing professionals.
seoTitle: Q-leap will be present at the Journée Française des Tests Logiciels (JFTL) 2024! - Q-Leap
body:
JOIN US IN PARIS FOR THE JOURNÉE FRANÇAISE DES TESTS LOGICIELS #JFTL on June 11, 2024

We’ll be there on Tuesday, June 11, 2024 to explore the world of software testing and quality system information.

The JFTL is France’s leading event for software testing and information systems quality professionals. This major event is a must for the French software testing community.

Well established in the digital landscape, the JFTL returns in 2024 for its 16th edition, as rich and lively as ever. Organized by the CFTL (Comité français des Tests Logiciels), this event is a unique opportunity to meet recognized experts and exchange experiences between professionals.

Our team will be on hand all day on June 11, 2024 to attend seminars and presentations, broaden our knowledge, get the latest market information and network with other major industry players.

We’re looking forward to attending the event and chatting with you there! If you’d like to meet us, let us know by sending an e-mail to contact@q-leap.eu, or send us a message via LinkedIn !

More information on this event can be found here.
